_note: Output of the LLM extraction stage (Prompts 1-3 in prompts/prompts.md). Produced by Claude following the prompts, because no model API is available in this workspace. Every 'evidence' string must be an exact substring of data/brd.md; pipeline.py checks this.

regulation_terms.why_open: Rule 2 defines 'transaction' but never says which transactions count as cash (channels, instruments, cash deposit machines, ATMs).
No test for when transactions are connected: same account, same customer, same day, related parties?
Calendar month or any rolling 30-day window.
Which exchange rate, from which source, on which date.
No list of categories is given.
Account holder only, or also a third party who deposits the cash.
Proposed by the model; the pipeline should find it is defined in Rule 2(1)(h) and drop it.

BR-01.text: A single cash transaction above INR 10 lakh is reportable.
BR-01.evidence: every cash transaction of a customer valued above INR 10,00,000

judge.label: stated
judge.rationale: The clause sets the more-than-ten-lakh threshold for cash transactions.

BR-01.text: A series of integrally connected cash transactions whose monthly aggregate exceeds INR 10 lakh is reportable.
BR-01.evidence: every series of integrally connected cash transactions whose monthly aggregate exceeds INR 10,00,000

judge.label: stated
judge.rationale: The clause states the monthly-aggregate rule for connected series.

BR-01.text: The aggregation window is the calendar month.

judge.label: refined
judge.rationale: The clause says 'within a month'; choosing the calendar month over a rolling window is not in the text, even though the BRD cites the clause.

BR-02.text: A cash transaction is one with CoreOne transaction type 'C'.

judge.label: refined
judge.rationale: The Rules never say which system transactions are cash; the atom maps the term to a system code.

BR-02.text: Only Branch Teller and Cash Deposit Machine channels count as cash.
BR-02.evidence: its channel is Branch Teller or Cash Deposit Machine

judge.label: refined
judge.rationale: Restricts the open term 'cash transaction' to two channels.

BR-02.text: Cash deposits through Cash Deposit Machines are in scope.
BR-02.evidence: Cash deposits through Cash Deposit Machines are in scope as agreed by the CTR Working Group on 12-Mar-2025

judge.label: refined
judge.rationale: A recorded internal decision on the scope of 'cash transaction'.

BR-02.evidence: ATM cash withdrawals are out of scope

judge.label: refined
judge.rationale: Excludes a cash channel; nothing in the clause gives a basis for it, and the BRD records none.

BR-03.text: Connected transactions are grouped per customer across all of that customer's accounts.
BR-03.evidence: all cash debits across all of the customer's accounts

judge.label: refined
judge.rationale: Chooses customer-level grouping as the meaning of 'integrally connected'.

BR-03.text: Customers are identified by the UCIC.

judge.label: none
judge.rationale: UCIC is an internal identifier; no clause deals with customer identity resolution.

BR-03.text: Debits and credits are aggregated separately, each tested against the threshold.
BR-03.evidence: summed separately from all cash credits

judge.label: refined
judge.rationale: The clause speaks of a monthly aggregate without saying whether debits and credits are netted, pooled or separated.

BR-04.text: Transactions below INR 50,000 inside a reportable series are not listed.
BR-04.evidence: individual transactions below INR 50,000 shall not be listed in the report

judge.label: none
judge.rationale: No clause sets a per-transaction floor; this narrows what is reported.

BR-05.text: Transfers between the bank's own internal accounts are excluded.
BR-05.evidence: Transactions between the bank's own internal (office) accounts shall be excluded from the report

judge.label: none
judge.rationale: No clause mentions internal or office accounts.

BR-06.text: Foreign-currency cash is valued in rupees before the threshold is applied.
BR-06.evidence: Foreign-currency cash transactions shall be converted to INR

judge.label: stated
judge.rationale: 'Or its equivalent in foreign currency' requires valuing foreign currency against the rupee threshold.

BR-06.text: The conversion uses the Treasury card rate of the transaction date.
BR-06.evidence: at the Treasury card rate of the transaction date

judge.label: refined
judge.rationale: The clause does not say which rate or date to use.

BR-07.text: Walk-in customers' cash transactions are grouped by the PAN on the voucher.
BR-07.evidence: grouped using the PAN recorded on the transaction voucher

judge.label: refined
judge.rationale: Chooses PAN as the linking key for walk-in customers.

BR-08.text: Each reported transaction carries its date, amount and currency.

judge.label: stated
judge.rationale: Rule 4(b) and (c) require amount, currency and date.

BR-08.text: The nature of a transaction is expressed as deposit or withdrawal.

judge.label: refined
judge.rationale: Rule 4(a) asks for the nature but gives no categories.

BR-08.text: Each reported transaction carries account number, customer name and branch code.
BR-08.evidence: account number, customer name and branch code

judge.label: refined
judge.rationale: Rule 4 delegates the full field list to what the Regulator specifies; these fields are not in the clause.

BR-09.text: Transaction attributes come from CoreOne TXN_HIST.
BR-09.evidence: CoreOne table TXN_HIST (TXN_DT, TXN_AMT, TXN_CCY, TXN_TYPE, CHNL_CD, ACCT_NO)

judge.label: none
judge.rationale: System mapping; outside the regulation by nature.

BR-09.text: Customer name comes from CUST_MASTER, joined on UCIC.
BR-09.evidence: Customer name shall be sourced from CUST_MASTER joined on UCIC

judge.label: none
judge.rationale: System mapping; outside the regulation by nature.

BR-10.text: The report uses FIU-IND's account-based XML format.

judge.label: refined
judge.open_term: such form as may be directed by the Director
judge.rationale: Rule 7(3) delegates the form to the Director; the atom names the resulting format.

BR-10.text: Reports must pass FIU-IND's validation utility before submission.
BR-10.evidence: pass the FIU-IND validation utility before submission

judge.label: refined
judge.open_term: such form as may be directed by the Director
judge.rationale: Validation against the directed form; the utility is not in the Rules.

BR-11.text: Submission is due by the 15th of the following month.
BR-11.evidence: by the 15th day of the succeeding month

judge.label: stated
judge.rationale: Rule 8(1) sets the 15th of the succeeding month.

BR-11.text: A draft is produced by the 5th working day for the Principal Officer's review.
BR-11.evidence: A draft shall be generated by the 5th working day for review by the Principal Officer

judge.label: none
judge.rationale: Rule 7(2) makes the Principal Officer responsible but sets no internal review timeline.

BR-12.text: Errors found after submission are corrected with a replacement report.
BR-12.evidence: corrected by filing a replacement report

judge.label: refined
judge.rationale: Rule 8(4) penalises delay in rectifying but does not say how a correction is filed.
